verdict: HETEROGENEOUS: a removable locus on 5/20 films only (mean best block +0.147, max +0.998). Report per-film, not as a group claim
verdict_original_MISSPECIFIED: LOCALISED: a spatial causal locus exists; the A6 feature probe is worth running
gate_note: The original gate used only the top-5 SHARE, a ratio with no magnitude floor, so it returned LOCALISED on a mean top-5 block effect of +0.036. Corrected gate adds an absolute floor on the single best block and a per-film count.
